To save the universe, Tenchi is going undercover—at an all-girl’s school! Can he survive the attention of cute girls at this not-so-ordinary school and put the timelines back into balance? Join the harem and fun in this series of shorts!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Note: The anime is set in Takahashi, the sponsors for the show, as the city hopes fans will come on a "pilgrimage" to see the setting of the anime, and plans to sell goods and host related events.

Per salvare l'universo, Tenchi sta andando sotto copertura in una scuola di tutte le ragazze! Può sopravvivere all'attenzione di ragazze carine in questa scuola non così ordinaria e rimettere le linee temporali in equilibrio? Unisciti all'harem e divertiti in questa serie di pantaloncini!

(Fonte: Crunchyroll)

Nota: L'anime è ambientato a Takahashi, gli sponsor per lo spettacolo, come la città spera che i fan verranno su un "pellegrinaggio" per vedere l'ambientazione dell'anime, e prevede di vendere beni e ospitare eventi correlati.
20790:
Kaito Kuroba, a normal teenage student whose father is often absent. When his father dies under mysterious circumstances, he is made aware of his father's secret identity; a famous international criminal known as International Criminal 1412: the Phantom Thief, and that he was murdered by a mysterious organization for refusing to aid them in retrieving the "Pandora Gem"; a mystical stone said to shed a "tear" during the passing of a particular comet (often called the 'Volley Comet'), the consumption of which bestows immortality.

He vows to prevent the organization from gaining immortality, and assumes his father's identity as he begins his quest for the gem. His only clues as to the gem's location are that it glows red under the full moon and that it is a doublet: a gem hidden within a larger gem. Thus, it would have to be a relatively large one with a bizarre history, and always stored in a place that never receives moonlight. He thus researches and steals famous priceless gems with odd histories from incredibly well-defended areas, and always returns them after the very next full moon.

Kaito Kuroba, un normale studente adolescente il cui padre è spesso assente. Quando il padre muore in circostanze misteriose, viene informato dell'identità segreta del padre; un famoso criminale internazionale noto come International Criminal 1412: il Ladro Fantasma, e che è stato assassinato da un'organizzazione misteriosa per aver rifiutato di aiutarli a recuperare la "Pandora Gem"; una pietra mistica ha detto di gettare un "lacrimonia" durante il passaggio di una particolare cometa (spesso chiamata "la Cometa Volley"), il consumo di cui concede immortalità.

Giura di impedire all'organizzazione di acquisire l'immortalità, e assume l'identità del padre quando inizia la sua ricerca per la gemma. I suoi unici indizi sulla posizione della gemma sono che brilla rossa sotto la luna piena e che è un doppiot: una gemma nascosta all'interno di una gemma più grande. Così, dovrebbe essere relativamente grande con una storia bizzarra, e sempre memorizzato in un luogo che non riceve mai il chiaro di luna. Ricercherà e ruba così famose gemme di valore con strane storie provenienti da aree incredibilmente ben difese, e le restituisce sempre dopo la prossima luna piena.
20854: Season 2 of Baby Steps. Maruo Eiichirou has begun his training in America and quickly realizes that he has still a long way to go. Facing his comrades in the daily matches helps him to realize his own weaknesses and his time overseas proves to be extremely valuable for his development, both as a tennis player and as a person.

Stagione 2 di Baby Steps. Maruo Eiichirou ha iniziato la sua formazione in America e si rende subito conto che ha ancora molta strada da fare. Affrontare i suoi compagni nelle partite quotidiane lo aiuta a realizzare le proprie debolezze e il suo tempo oltreoceano si rivela estremamente prezioso per il suo sviluppo, sia come tennista che come persona.
20918:
Third season of the Monogatari Series, part 1/5. Contains the arc Yotsugi Doll from the Tsukimonogatari light novel.

One day in February, Koyomi Araragi was taking a bath with his younger sister Tsukihi amidst finishing his studies for the college entrance exam. This was also following the incident involving Nadeko Sengoku, which was successfully amended behind the scenes by Deishu Kaiki. Koyomi noticed a change on his body “that could not be overlooked” and sought advice from Shinobu Oshino leading him to contact Yozuru Kagenui and Yotsugi Ononoki. Was this change signifying retribution for everything that Koyomi has done?!

Terza stagione della Serie Monogatari, parte 1/5. Contiene l'arco Yotsugi Bambola dal romanzo di luce Tsukimonogatari.

Un giorno di febbraio, Koyomi Araragi stava facendo un bagno con la sorella minore Tsukihi tra aver terminato gli studi per l'esame di ammissione al college. Questo è stato anche seguito l'incidente che ha coinvolto Nadeko Sengoku, che è stato modificato con successo dietro le quinte da Deishu Kaiki. Koyomi ha notato un cambiamento sul suo corpo che non poteva essere trascurato e ha cercato consigli da Shinobu Oshino che lo porta a contattare Yozuru Kagenui e Yotsugi Ononoki. Questo cambiamento significava punizione per tutto quello che Koyomi ha fatto?!
21046: Komori Yui is still adapting to the life of living with the sadistic Sakamaki vampire brothers, how will her relationship fare between them throughout the rest of her time in high school?
Komori Yui si sta ancora adattando alla vita di vivere con i sadici fratelli vampiri Sakamaki, come andrà la sua relazione tra loro durante il resto del suo tempo al liceo?
21110: After two demon girls, Maria the succubus and Mio the demoness, force Basara into a contract that makes him their master, the trio form a complicated master-servant relationship. Basara is the last descendant of a demon-fighting hero clan, but as master of two demon girls, he finds himself defending them instead of fighting them.

Dopo due demoni, Maria il succubo e Mio la demonezza, forzano Basara in un contratto che lo rende il loro padrone, il trio forma un complicato rapporto maestro-servo. Basara è l'ultimo discendente di un clan eroe che combatte contro i demoni, ma come padrone di due ragazze demoni, si trova a difenderli invece di combatterli.
21238: The story centers around class 1-7 of Tennogofune Academy, where all the students with "bad karma" or misfortune seem to have been gathered. Hibari, a student in this class, meets the unlucky Hanako and the perennially unhealthy Botan on her first day of school, and together they try to find a way to turn their school life into a happy one.

La storia si concentra intorno alla classe 1-7 dell'Accademia Tennogofune, dove tutti gli studenti con "cattivo karma" o sfortuna sembrano essere stati riuniti. Hibari, una studentessa di questa classe, incontra l'infelice Hanako e il perennemente malsano Botan nel suo primo giorno di scuola, e insieme cercano di trovare un modo per trasformare la loro vita scolastica in una vita felice.
21302:
Wagamama High Spec revolves around Kouki Narumi, a high school student who also draws a manga serialized in a weekly magazine. Because the manga he draws is a risqué romantic comedy, he keeps this fact a secret from everyone around him, with his younger sister Toa and his best friend Mihiro being the only ones who know.

But one day, as the student council president Kaoruko Rokuonji is searching for male members for the student council, he finds out that Kouki is the manga's author. Kouki joins the student council in exchange for Kaoruko not revealing his secret. However, the vice president, Ashe R. Sakuragi, strongly opposes him joining, and in the midst of all this, various requests and troubles of students begin to pile up.

Wagamama High Spec ruota intorno a Kouki Narumi, uno studente della scuola superiore che disegna anche un manga serializzato in un settimanale. Poiché il manga che disegna è una commedia romantica, tiene questo fatto segreto a tutti quelli che lo circondano, con la sorella minore Toa e il suo migliore amico Mihiro che sono gli unici a saperlo.

Ma un giorno, mentre il presidente del consiglio studentesco Kaoruko Rokuonji sta cercando membri maschili per il consiglio studentesco, scopre che Kouki è l'autore del manga. Kouki si unisce al consiglio studentesco in cambio di Kaoruko non rivelando il suo segreto. Tuttavia, il vicepresidente, Ashe R. Sakuragi, si oppone fortemente a lui che si unisce, e in mezzo a tutto questo, diverse richieste e problemi di studenti cominciano a accumularsi.
21366:
Rei Kiriyama is a 17 year old boy who recently started living alone, financed by his salary as a professional Shogi player. Despite his independence, however, he's yet to mature emotionally, and his problems continue to haunt him in his daily life. His relationship with his adoptive family is strained, and he has difficulties interacting with his fellow high school students.

Meanwhile, his professional career in Shogi has entered a slump. Burdened with the heavy expectations placed upon him, his wins and losses are fluctuating as his record and progression into the ranks begin to stagnate.

Acquainted with Rei are the three Kawamoto sisters: Akari, Hinata, and Momo. Unlike Rei, they live happily in their modest home, which they warmly welcome Rei into as if he were one of their own.  He frequently visits the family, interacting with them and receiving the kind of care and affection he never quite had while under his foster home.

This is the story of Rei's triumphs and failures, relationships new and old, and his growth as a person.

Rei Kiriyama è un ragazzo di 17 anni che ha iniziato da poco a vivere da solo, finanziato dal suo stipendio come giocatore professionista Shogi. Nonostante la sua indipendenza, tuttavia, deve ancora maturare emotivamente, e i suoi problemi continuano a perseguitarlo nella sua vita quotidiana. La sua relazione con la sua famiglia adottiva è tesa, e ha difficoltà ad interagire con i suoi compagni di scuola superiore.

Nel frattempo, la sua carriera professionale a Shogi è entrata in crisi. Con le pesanti aspettative che gli sono state imposte, le sue vittorie e le sue perdite fluttuano mentre il suo record e la progressione nei ranghi iniziano a ristagnare.

Conosciute con Rei sono le tre sorelle Kawamoto: Akari, Hinata e Momo. A differenza di Rei, vivono felicemente nella loro modesta casa, che accolgono calorosamente Rei come se fosse uno di loro. Visita spesso la famiglia, interagendo con loro e ricevendo il tipo di cura e affetto che non ha mai avuto mentre era in affidamento.

Questa è la storia dei trionfi e dei fallimenti di Rei, delle relazioni nuove e vecchie e della sua crescita come persona.
21558:
Despite the recent Akuma attack, the members of the Black Order are in high spirits as they set about moving to a new base. Immediately upon his arrival, however, Allen Walker is suddenly called by the Central Agency and has his arm forcefully sealed by the Order. He is then led to a surprising meeting with his master, General Cross Marian, who reveals staggering secrets surrounding the enigmatic 14th Noah.

A phantom thief incident, the arrival of a mysterious group of Exorcists, the death of an important comrade, and an all-out battle against the Noah Family—just what does this mean for Allen, Yuu Kanda, and the rest of the Order? This is but the beginning of a series of strange, seemingly unconnected events that lead to something far greater.

Nonostante il recente attacco di Akuma, i membri dell'Ordine Nero sono in pieno spirito mentre si spostano verso una nuova base. Subito dopo il suo arrivo, tuttavia, Allen Walker viene improvvisamente chiamato dall'Agenzia Centrale e ha il suo braccio sigillato con forza dall'Ordine. Viene poi condotto ad un incontro sorprendente con il suo maestro, il generale Croce Mariana, che rivela segreti sbalorditivi che circondano l'enigmatico 14° Noè.

Un incidente fantasma, l'arrivo di un misterioso gruppo di esorcisti, la morte di un importante compagno, e una battaglia totale contro la famiglia Noè... cosa significa questo per Allen, Yuu Kanda e il resto dell'Ordine? Questo è solo l'inizio di una serie di strani eventi apparentemente estranei che portano a qualcosa di molto più grande.
21686: Kae Serinuma is what you'd call a "fujoshi." When she sees boys getting along with each other, she loves to indulge in wild fantasies! One day her favorite anime character dies and the shock causes her to lose a ton of weight. Then four hot guys at school ask her out, but that isn't exciting to her at all — she'd rather see them date each other!

Kae Serinuma e' quella che chiameresti un "fujoshi." Quando vede i ragazzi andare d'accordo tra loro, ama indulgere in fantasie selvaggie! Un giorno muore il suo personaggio preferito e lo shock le fa perdere un sacco di peso. Poi quattro ragazzi sexy a scuola le chiedono di uscire, ma questo non è affatto eccitante per lei Preferisce vederli uscire insieme!
21750:
The alien Wulgaru’s last assault against humanity was foiled by the heroic actions of the genetically enhanced humans known as the Evolved Children in their advanced AHSMB battle armor, but now a new attack has been launched against Earth under an even deadlier champion, Diorna, created from the fusion of DNA from two Wulgaru Royals.

Unfortunately, Izuru Hitachi, the leader of Team Rabbits who defeated the Wulgaru Royal Jiart, is still out of action and recovering, so the task of marshalling the Majestic Princes and stopping Diorna falls upon the unready shoulders of Toshikazu Asagi. Together with the remaining members of Team Rabbits and the recently created Team Fawn, it’s up to Asagi to hold the line against the most ruthless adversary yet.
21814: One year after winning the Gunpla Battle National Championships, Team Try Fighters is invited by Yajima Trading to a remote island to test the company's new battle system. Sekai and Fumina arrive on the island, only to discover that Gyanko, Shia, and Minato were also invited. Yuuma declines the offer as he is assisting Mirai on a photoshoot, only to realize that he and his teammates are on the same island. Meanwhile, the Nielsen Lab experiences an anomaly with their new Plavsky particles forms a giant crystal and cause Gunpla on the island to go out of control. The Gunpla Fighters must band together to stop the crystal from wreaking havoc on all Gunpla Battle Systems around the world.
21878: An angel at the top of an angel school has descended to the human world! However, she has already acclimated to the life of the human world so much that she ends up leading a self-indulgent life, skipping school all the time and being absorbed in online games. Gabriel soon forgets about her original goal to make human beings happy and has turned into a lazy and hopeless angel, or a “sloppy angel” in short. Amazingly, she swears to continue to fully enjoy the pleasure of various entertainments of the human world.

Un angelo in cima ad una scuola di angelo è sceso nel mondo umano! Tuttavia, lei si è già acclimatata alla vita del mondo umano così tanto che finisce per condurre una vita auto-indulgente, saltando scuola tutto il tempo e di essere assorbito nei giochi online. Gabriele si dimentica presto del suo obiettivo originale di rendere felici gli esseri umani e si è trasformato in un angelo pigro e senza speranza, o un angelo sciatto in breve. Incredibilmente, giura di continuare a godere appieno del piacere di vari intrattenimenti del mondo umano.
87478: A new series following the cat named Tama and his many friends.
97590: The historical novel series depicts Heizou Hasegawa, who metes justice on wrongdoers and supervises the crackdown on arsonists and robbers in Japan's Edo period (1603-1868).

La serie di romanzi storici raffigura Heizou Hasegawa, che mette in mezzo la giustizia sugli ingiusti e supervisiona la repressione contro piromani e rapinatori nel periodo giapponese di Edo (1603-1868).
97910:
The All-Japan High School Soccer Tournament Finals with Touin Academy.

Note: Bundled with limited editions of the 26th-28th volumes of the Days manga.

Le finali del torneo di calcio della scuola superiore di tutto il Giappone con Touin Academy.

Nota: Bundled con edizioni limitate del 26-28 ° volumi del manga Days.
98998: Joker has come to Japan to steal the Eagle Talon Society's secret weapons in his continued scheme for pure chaos. However, the Justice League is on his trail, but there's something off with Batman. Now, it's up to Eagle Talon to go find out what's wrong with him, and that means going back in time to Bruce Wayne's most traumatic experience, the murder of his parents. The Eagle Talon Society also have to keep their eyes on their production budget, especially with most of that money going towards the licensing fee for DC's popular characters. Will the Eagle Talon Society and the Justice League be able to stop the Joker before their budget dries up, and they're reduced to simple stick figures!?
99638: What happens when a big brother idolizes his little twin sisters? All sorts of mischief that’s what! Meet Rise and Airi, twin sisters who love to hang out with their friends, go to cute pastry shops and annoy their big brother. Watch as these adorable pint-size girls learn to navigate through life while making sure their brother doesn’t go too over the top.

Cosa succede quando un fratello maggiore idolatra le sue sorelle gemelle? Tutti i tipi di mali che si rendono conto di cosa! Incontra Rise e Airi, sorelle gemelle che amano uscire con i loro amici, andare in pasticcerie carine e infastidire il loro fratello maggiore. Guardate come queste adorabili ragazze di dimensioni pinte imparano a navigare attraverso la vita, assicurandosi che il loro fratello doesn't andare troppo oltre la cima.
100790:
He's chivalrous, cunning, and his looks are anything "butt"...

Meet “Butt Detective”, a gentleman whose catch phrase is, "Hmm...I smell a case."

Every day, he poots the big city's cases to rest.
101046: Several years have passed since Binan High's Earth Defense Club saved the world from an alien invasion that sought to sap the world of love—okay, maybe that's how it happened. The truth is that no one really remembers if something like that happened or not, and now five friends-of-convenience share the defunct Earth Defense clubroom to goof off after school. But even if they don't know the club's history, their gathering at the local bathhouse attracts the attention of another adorable extraterrestrial: Karurusu, the otter-prince of Honyaraland. As part of his planet's conquest initiative—"tributary outreach program"—Karurusu transforms these five misfits into magic knights who will bring happiness to all lost souls. Unfortunately, the fox-prince Rafunui has his own ideas about how to improve this Earth colony, empowering his own trio of dark knights to oppose this new batch of magical boys.
101302: Earth is at peace after The Tournament of Power but Goku continues to train, knowing there are ever-stronger forces in the universe. With the arrival of a Saiyan warrior named Broly, Goku and Vegeta face their most dangerous challenge yet. The film also chronicles the history of the Saiyans and the background story of these three Saiyans with different destinies connected to the turbulent period of their now extinct race.

La Terra è in pace dopo il Torneo del Potere, ma Goku continua ad allenarsi, sapendo che ci sono forze sempre più forti nell'universo. Con l'arrivo di un guerriero Saiyan di nome Broly, Goku e Vegeta affrontano ancora la loro sfida più pericolosa. Il film racconta anche la storia dei Saiyan e la storia di questi tre Saiyan con diversi destini legati al periodo turbolento della loro razza ormai estinta.
101430: A horror spin on the classic tale of "The Little Match Girl".
101814: The entire population of a city disappeared—vanished without a trace. Yuki, the sole survivor, joins Takuya, a contract courier, on a perilous journey to find answers within the newly named ghost town “Lost”. With a letter from Yuki’s father as the pair’s only lead, a secretive organization refuses to let Yuki and Takuya’s meddling go unchecked.

L'intera popolazione di una città scomparve senza lasciare traccia. Yuki, l'unico sopravvissuto, si unisce a Takuya, un corriere contrattuale, in un pericoloso viaggio per trovare risposte all'interno della nuova città fantasma di nome Lost. Con una lettera di Yukii, padre di Yukii, come la coppia solo guidano, un'organizzazione segreta rifiuta di lasciare Yuki e Takuyai che si intromettono andare incontrollato.
101878: The third season of Ling Yu.
102454: Based on the figure skater Mao Asada. On July 10th, Tekken posted the full version of the video on his official YouTube channel. The story took 2,890 hand drawn sheets. Tekken originally made a short version back in 2015 but when Mao Asada announced her retirement on April 10, 2017--he decided to expand upon it by creating 5 minutes worth of additional content.
102582:
Based on the 4-koma spin-off manga by Akane, serialised in Dengeki Maou since 2011.

Takane does not want to put the kotatsu away, even though it's spring. This leads to a huge court battle lead by the Producer and Takanya, on whether the kotatsu should be taken away or not.

Note: Bundled with the limited edition of the Puchimas! manga, volume 6.
102646: A commercial for Nissin brand ramen noodles. It tells the story of how instant ramen first came to be, as told through rap verse.
102710: A study for the relation between movements and music.
103222: Legends, myths, magic... Humanity has finally had a chance encounter with a world that had been all but forgotten among all its scientific developments. However, this reunion is not a happy one. Monsters invading from the world of the dead render modern weapons useless, leaving the fate of humanity uncertain. But with help from the Otherworld Trade Agreement, mankind gains a possible means of returning from the brink of death in the form of magical girls. These girls finally lead humanity to victory. However, even this victory proves to be no more than the beginning of a new battle.

Leggende, miti, magia... L'umanità ha finalmente avuto un incontro casuale con un mondo che era stato tutto ma dimenticato tra tutti i suoi sviluppi scientifici. Tuttavia, questa riunione non è felice. I mostri che invadono il mondo dei morti rendono inutili le armi moderne, lasciando incerto il destino dell'umanità. Ma con l'aiuto dell'accordo commerciale degli Otherworld, l'umanità ottiene un possibile mezzo per tornare dall'orlo della morte sotto forma di ragazze magiche. Queste ragazze finalmente portano l'umanità alla vittoria. Tuttavia, anche questa vittoria si rivela essere solo l'inizio di una nuova battaglia.
103350: The hilarious everyday lives of ancient deities and mythical creatures in the modern world.
103414: An anime made entirely in sumi-e following a child fox spirit and his morphing ability for haunting but he ends up getting scared himself.
103478: Legs and shoes float across the screen in this short film by Yoriko Mizushiri.
103926: Death is the gateway to birth. The deceased crosses the line to join the kingdom of the dead. He sees there the dance of the sperm and the egg. He is drawn towards the sky. This is the path to the afterlife.
103990: Teaming up as an agent squad, GG Bond and his pals travel around the world to help people solve their problems. Although their journeys are full of danger and unknown, these brave agents are highly committed to their missions and never step back. On their way of the global adventure, they can also learn about local cultures and customs, which are accompanied with funny stuff and interesting stories. You never know what they will run into in their next mission...
104182: A short animation by Taku Furukawa.
104374:
Depiction of an incident that happened one night in as everyone returns to their hometown for the holidays, told from a child's point of view.

1st Year Work 2011 by Senri Iida, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.
105334: Tohru Honda thought her life was headed for misfortune when a family tragedy left her living in a tent. When her small home is discovered by the mysterious Soma clan, she suddenly finds herself living with Yuki, Kyo, and Shigure Soma. But she quickly learns their family has a bizarre secret of their own: when hugged by the opposite sex, they turn into the animals of the Zodiac!

Tohru Honda pensava che la sua vita fosse destinata alla disgrazia quando una tragedia familiare l'ha lasciata in una tenda. Quando la sua piccola casa viene scoperta dal misterioso clan Soma, improvvisamente si ritrova a vivere con Yuki, Kyo e Shigure Soma. Ma impara subito che la loro famiglia ha un loro strano segreto: abbracciati dal sesso opposto, si trasformano in animali dello Zodiac!
105974: Sanpei is a boy beekeeper and the sole survivor of an accident that killed his entire family. Sanpei meets Chiyo, a girl who gets stung by a bee, and starts a new life in her village. Eventually, Sanpei cultivates the land that the villagers had abandoned, and then disappears. In the land now filled with flowers, Chiyo waits, believing Sanpei will return.
108534: The culinary daily of an office worker named Iinuma.
108598: In the 19th century empire after the war, rose “mechanical boxing” which involved people who had had their bodies modified. Under his uncle’s tutelage, Levius, a lonely youth who lost his father in the war and whose mother is in a coma, enters the mechanical boxing scene.

Nell'impero del 19 ° secolo dopo la guerra, è aumentato pugilato meccanico che ha coinvolto la gente che aveva fatto modificare i loro corpi. Sotto la tutela dello zio, Levius, un giovane solitario che ha perso suo padre in guerra e la cui madre è in coma, entra nella scena della boxe meccanica.
108726: Ojamajo Doremi: Owarai Gekijou is an original net animation spin-off based on the Ojamajo Doremi series. This series consists of 26 short episodes that were uploaded fortnightly on Toei Animation's YouTube channel. This series features chibi versions of the character designs from the light novel series.
109366: A short film by Shinichi Suzuki.
109942: Aesop is a trouble-making young boy who finds himself in another world filled with creatures he never believed to exist, such as fairies and talking donkeys. He sets off to find a way back to the normal world. On his journey he befriends many classical creatures from well-known fables and encounters many trials, each teaching him a valuable lesson.
110646: In the 21st century, the rapid development of the human society has broken the equilibrium between the realms of human, immortal and monster. Su Moting is an ordinary working girl living in the human world. She is also the "son of the immortal and the monster". Driven away from home by her parents, Su teams up with an immortal and a monster, and the three of them start their hilarious daily life.
111734: The film centers on the love relationship among the band's bassist Haruki Nakayama, drummer Akihiko Kaji, and Akihiko's roommate and ex-boyfriend Ugetsu Murata.
Il film si concentra sul rapporto d'amore tra il bassista Haruki Nakayama, il batterista Akihiko Kaji e il compagno di stanza ed ex ragazzo di Akihiko Ugetsu Murata.
113206: Okawara was commissioned to create this animated short to promote the live-action TV series Frankenstein's Love. Loosely based on Mary Shelley's Frankenstein, it depicts the lonely life of a monster over the course of more than a century.
113270:
Earth is the place and the established existence.

 Earth is also a ball of dust, and a capricious object. At the avalanche of time-layer, falling deep down into the ground, you can see the fallacious landscape far from reality. The body recognizes the reality of the world by touching the landscape to regain the reality. It is an adventure between the real and the unreal.

Graduate Work 2012 from Sonomi Takada, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation.
113718: A series of ten short stories featuring anthropomorphic animals animated with yarn by Tadanari Okamoto, and music by Yasuo Higuchi. "Looking at the mischiefs and soldiers in the story, the kids themselves can be kind, kind, beauty, miserable, I hope to discover something, I created it with such a wish."
113846: An old frying pan accidentally gets tossed out and ends up encountering many animals in his journey.
114294:
The Yotsuya Alphabet tells the story of a girl caught in a surreal world through the use of Japanese characters.

Graduate Work 2010, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation
116982: While living as an ordinary deliveryman and motor racing fan, Nezha encounters old nemeses and must rediscover his powers to protect his loved ones.
118134:
A man walks in a crowd.  He cannot stand the crowd but to cover his ears.  Then it disappears and he gets lost in a white void space.  In that space there is no other man but himself.  He had nothing to identify himself and his existence was to come to naught.  He starts to struggle to get away from there.

1st Year Work 2010, Tokyo University of the Arts, Graduate School of Film and New Media, Department of Animation
118390:
The story takes place in the town of Izumo, in Shimane prefecture, a place steeped in folklore and ancestral traditions.

Among them is the myth of Kamiari, which has given rise over the centuries to a series of celebrations that take place in October.
